chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abu Maryam from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) from the man

How does he divorce his wife while she is menstruating, having one period in every three months? He said: He divorces her with one divorce at the beginning of the month. So when three months have passed from the day he divorced her, she is definitively divorced from him, and he is one of the suitors.

key_terms.بَانَتْ مِنْهُ: she is definitively divorced from him

ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a woman who menstruates once every three months if divorced?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-istibsar clarifies the iddah for a woman with irregular menstruation (mustahaddah) who divorces her husband during her period, establishing that the waiting period is three lunar months from the date of divorce. It highlights the Shia juristic view that such a divorce is effective immediately, distinguishing it from the standard three-cycle rule for regular menstruation. The phrase 'khaatin min al-khuttab' signifies that she becomes fully divorced (mubarrat) and requires a new marriage contract if the husband wishes to remarry her.
